directoryName: Arkansas Animal Rescue and Shelter Directory
description: Animal shelters, humane societies, foster-based rescues, animal-control organizations, and other animal-welfare resources in Arkansas.
sourceNotes: Merged from the existing Arkansas organizations directory and the user-provided rescues and humane societies list.
Human-service organizations such as food banks, community-action agencies, reentry programs, and housing organizations were intentionally excluded from this animal directory.
Duplicate and alternate-name entries were consolidated where the source material clearly indicated the same organization.
New organizations taken only from the user-provided source list have minimal details and are marked for direct verification before reliance.
